#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

#include <climits>

using namespace std;

const double EPS = 1e-9;
const int INF = 1e9;
const long long LINF = (long long) 1e18;
const int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
const double PI = acos(-1.0);

int go(long long n) {
    if (n == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    long long k = 1;
    int cnt = 1;
    while (k * 10 + 1 < n) {
        k = k * 10 + 1;
        cnt++;
    }
    return (int) min(go(n % k) + n / k * cnt,
                     go((k * 10 + 1 - n) % k) + (cnt + 1) + (k * 10 + 1 - n) / k * cnt);
}

void solve() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << go(n) << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
